## What it is

A broad-headed locking pin that replaces the M6 cradle bolt. Print one, plus a spare if desired.

## Design notes

The 5.8 mm shaft passes through the existing 6.4 mm cradle slots and boom hole. Its shoulder spans the 5 mm cradle mount and 16 mm boom with 0.3 mm axial clearance. A 4.4 mm neck near the lower tip receives the side-snapping retaining clip. The tip returns to full diameter through a support-free 45° flare, preventing the clip from falling off. The 16 mm head is large enough to pull out by hand.

## Don't

Do not enlarge the shaft past the existing 6.4 mm openings. Do not remove the reduced neck; it is the positive stop that prevents the clip sliding off the end.
